name: booking-bar
title: Booking bar
description: A horizontal search bar for stays, rentals and rides: dates in one two-month calendar, guests as counters and a button, stacking into a form on a phone.
docs: Pass onSearch, which receives the stay (from and to), the number of nights, the adults, the children and the location when the reader searches and everything is in order, and optionally locations (a value, a label and a description), minNights, maxGuests, minDate, weekStartsOn, defaultValue and locale. Days are calendar days at midnight in the reader's own time zone; in defaultValue write them as ISO dates (2026-12-18) so a value that crosses from a Server Component never shifts with a time zone. The dates are one picker: a two-month calendar from 640px and one month below, where the stay is a band, pointing at or moving to a day previews it, days before minDate and days closer to the check-in than minNights cannot be chosen, and pressing one says why in words (Minimum stay is 2 nights.). Once a stay exists the number of nights is said in words in the field (18 Dec to 21 Dec, 3 nights). The guests are two counters in a panel, adults from one, with a limit on the total that the panel states in words. A search without dates, or with a stay shorter than the minimum, says so under the bar, marks the dates and puts focus on them. Every part is labelled and works by keyboard: arrow keys, Page Up and Page Down, Home and End in the calendar, Enter to choose, Escape to close. From 768px the parts sit in one raised bar; below it they stack as a form. defaultOpen starts the dates or the guests panel open, which is for documentation and screenshots: an open panel takes focus when the page loads. The calendar and the location list are their own files (range-calendar and location-field), built for this bar, so that every word they say to assistive technology comes from labels. labels translates every fixed word, errors included.
